esbuild.reason: drives a native platform binary through child_process and an ESM binary loader; the npm package has no in-browser build
esbuild.remediation: esbuild-wasm is registered as a curated WASM tool: the CLI (esbuild --version, stdin/file transform) is dispatched by the container's command routing; the JS API of the 'esbuild' npm package itself still fails with 'Unsupported platform'

argon2.reason: native .node addon built with node-gyp; argon2 itself ships no browser or WASM build
argon2.remediation: the bundle-time native-addon variant alias (packages/wasm-registry/src/bundle.ts) maps 'argon2' to argon2-wasm@0.9.0 before node-gyp-build can run; note the WASM API differs (hash() -> { hash, hashHex, encoded }, no verify())

bcrypt.reason: native .node addon via node-pre-gyp; bcrypt ships no WASM or browser build
bcrypt.remediation: the bundle-time native-addon variant alias maps 'bcrypt' to bcryptjs@3.0.2 (pure JS, API-compatible) before node-pre-gyp can run

lightningcss.reason: loads a native .node binding through per-platform optional dependencies; no WASM fallback ships in this package
lightningcss.remediation: the bundle-time native-addon variant alias maps 'lightningcss' to lightningcss-wasm@1.33.0 (napi-wasm); its init() needs an explicit wasm URL because new URL(..., import.meta.url) cannot resolve inside the bundled module scope

rspack.reason: @rspack/core requires its native Rust binding (@rspack/binding-*, a .node addon) via dynamic require; the browser build is a separate package
rspack.remediation: use @rspack/browser; @rspack/core itself has no WASM path

turbo.reason: turbo is a wrapper around a native Rust binary; there is no browser-compatible build
turbo.remediation: none; keep turbo on Node, no WASM or browser story exists
